tours.name: Sigiriya Day Tour
tours.description: Visit the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, in a comfortable air-conditioned vehicle with a private driver for the day.
highlights: Views over the Central Province lowlands
Optional stop at a local village or spice garden

tours.name: Galle Day Tour
tours.description: Explore the historic Galle Fort along Sri Lanka's south coast, with time to enjoy colonial architecture, boutique shops, and ocean views.
highlights: Coastal scenery along the southern coastline

tours.name: Kandy Day Tour
tours.description: Discover the cultural capital of Sri Lanka, home to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and scenic hill-country views.
highlights: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
